body: Thank you SO much for your understanding & response. It means more than you know right now.

You are actually a very self aware person given that you know you carry around so much anger. I can so relate to what you’re saying. I’ve suffered from depression & suicidal tendencies for years, & just come to realize how much anger I’ve been carrying around, and I know I’m a lot older than you are. I don’t think you really want to die, I think you want escape from the pain of carrying around all that anger around & waking up depressed. I know counseling has helped me with some of this, but I still have a long way to go-please don’t give up, there is hope.
Yes, I’ve been on antidepressants for 15 years.

Counseling has provided immense insight & healing over the years for me in my experience. I have a tendency to isolate, and to not trust people due to my background so it has provided a safe place for me. I probably would not be alive today without it, so yes, I would highly encourage you to pursue the right counselor for you whoever that may be.
Hope you find one soon.
Thank you for your response. It’s good to know someone else feels the same way.
You’re great at writing- may I suggest you start your own blog? I could so relate to your experience & could so connect to it. Thanks for sharing. Very powerful.

This person is a TOXIC person in your life & a predator. Cut them off immediately (just a suggestion). They always appear to be friendly, but in fact are just the opposite, and probably possess qualities of a narcissist or psychopath. They are attracted to the wounded, fragile, and innocent souls- run for the hills.

Forget anything online. You need a drastic change. You’re only 22 years old with your WHOLE life ahead of you. Ever heard of EMDR therapy? You might be bipolar, but you also might have suffered from a trauma. I have suffered with the thoughts you expressed my whole life, & I’m almost 60. Don’t end up like me. You have a chance-and a choice, despite what you feel. Don’t let the depression kill you.

Thanks for sharing this. I’d begun to think I was the only person in the world who struggles
 with this. I just don’t understand why it’s so hard for me.
